column1: # Bingux icon names: every icon is named after what it draws (docs: ~/dev/bingux-doop/docs/icon-names.md).
# One row per icon: the shape name, then every other name it answers to, tab separated. The first other name that
# is a file in src/ is the drawing the icon keeps; any other file named in the row is a duplicate drawing and goes.
# The other names are the freedesktop (Adwaita) names the set used to have and the names other programs send
# (gnome-settings-daemon's on-screen display, BlueZ devices). Only this file holds them: build.py writes the shell's
# BinguxIconAliases.js and Rust's `Icon::from_freedesktop` from it, rename.py renames everything else by it, and
# ui-lint rejects them in Bingux code.
# BlueZ camera-video is the video camera, not the webcam: BlueZ gives it to camcorders and video cameras, and
# Adwaita's camera-video is a camcorder; camera-web is the webcam's own name.
